body: Sulit check ito kahit isang qualifying month lang: at the cited FY2026 rate, one month is ¥17,920, so hindi kailangan maabot ang full ¥215,040 bago maging worth the hassle. Ang key is huwag ma-distract sa headline maximum—compute mo muna ilang months ang natitira before age 1. Kung 2 months lang, ¥35,840 pa rin iyon for a relatively simple filing. Rare case na ang admin work may ganitong obvious peso—este yen—per minute return.
